messages:
maria: FYI planning a maintenance window for az-east-2 Tue Sep 9 03:00-06:00 UTC. Goal: NIC microcode + netstack patch + orderly soft reboots of GPU nodes. We'll do rolling waves to avoid full pool impacts. No API blackout expected but burst capacity will be reduced. posting plan & asks below.
jonathan: can we exempt dedicated-prod and highmem-reserved pools? those are hosting paid reserved tenants.
lee: +1 exclude those. i'll apply a temporary tag `no-preseed` so they aren't touched.
anya: last time cold caches tanked tail latency. what's the kv/prefix-cache strategy this round?
maria: we'll take KV snapshots, run a staggered preseed to warm caches on target machines before traffic moves. plan: 10% seeds every 10m, verify qps/latency, then continue.
jonathan: rough cost estimate if we preseed aggressively? we might double token egress for ~2h for primers.
lee: estimated extra egress ~= $3.8k for that window (back-of-envelope). can we smooth by throttling primers to 5% batches?
maria: yes we can reduce batch size to 5% per 8m intervals to spread cost. ops tradeoff is longer window.
anya: add routing fallback to a quantized variant if p90 spikes. better to shed gracefully than timeout.
maria: will add routing fallback policy to `rtd-small-q4` and set soft-retry to 3.
deploy-bot: calendar event created: "az-east-2 netstack + NIC microcode" Tue Sep 9 03:00 UTC — owners: maria, jonathan.
jonathan: tagging @support-team to notify large hosted customers in az-east-2 (esp acme-inc).
support-team: noted — we'll draft an outbound note. acme-inc is on dedicated-prod so they should be unaffected but we'll still inform them.
anya: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/az-east-2-kvseed.md — follow section "preseed-validation".
maria: quick commands we'll use: `kubectl label nodes -l pool=az-east-2 preseed=true` and `./kv-primer --rate 200rps --targets $(nodes) --model rtd-legacy`. i'll also paste the canary checks into the runbook.
lee: recommend adding a temporary routing weight reduction for heavy batch jobs during window to preserve inference capacity for low-latency traffic.
maria: good idea — will add weight policy to deprioritize `batch-heavy` tag by 40% for duration.
jonathan: one ask from ops: start at 03:00 UTC to avoid APAC evening peak. any objections?
anya: fine from my side. prefer that to risking APAC latency.
maria: moving window to 03:00-06:00 UTC. updating calendar + runbook. final call in 10m for objections. :thumbsup:
jonathan: lgtm. thanks.
lee: i'll run a quick capacity probe 30m before start and post results here.
anya: if we see >5% error uptick during seeds, we trigger rollback plan in runbook (step 7).
maria: copied rollback steps into the thread and runbook. rolling wave config, primer throttle, fallback routing, and contact list are all updated.
deploy-bot: reminder set for 30m preflight and 5m before start.
